---
title: "AI for Industry"
subtitle: "Support and training for industrial companies"
---

I help industrial companies make AI **useful and profitable, from data to decision**: identifying the AI projects that make sense for the company, checking that the data allow them, and carrying them through to a tool that teams actually use. I also train the engineers and managers who will lead AI in their organisations.

My approach combines the skills of an **economist and a data scientist**, to link every project to its economic value, with a perspective independent of any software vendor.

## Areas of work

- **Data and AI-maturity diagnosis** — start from the industrial need to qualify the data and identify what has to be consolidated.
- **Decision-support tools** — multi-criteria scoring for planners (maintenance, production, menu planning…).
- **Predictive models and optimisation** — cost estimation, machine settings, quality.
- **Project scoping and follow-up** — from the use case to a tool adopted by the teams.

## Case studies

::: {.cases}
::: {.case}
#### Optimising machine tests
[Manufacturer · compressors]{.sector}

**Challenge:** improve the tuning tests (PID) of machines designed and produced on site.

**Approach:** analysis of test data and optimisation of PID parameters.

**Result:** 80% of tests could be improved, a potential of €500k per year.
:::

::: {.case}
#### AI-based mould quotation
[Mould maker · plastics]{.sector}

**Challenge:** quote custom moulds faster and more accurately.

**Approach:** machine-learning cost estimation model; making the data and the process more reliable (learning from accepted quotes only).

**Result:** faster, more consistent quotes.
:::

::: {.case}
#### Menu planning
[Institutional catering]{.sector}

**Challenge:** balance cost, feasibility, compliance with the EGalim law and diner satisfaction.

**Approach:** multi-criteria scoring of menus for the dietitian who plans them.

**Result:** faster, more objective trade-offs.
:::

::: {.case}
#### Prioritising maintenance
[Manufacturing SME]{.sector}

**Challenge:** give the planner a clear view of the condition of critical equipment.

**Approach:** equipment scoring method based on machine data.

**Result:** synthetic information to prioritise interventions.
:::

::: {.case}
#### Quality data diagnosis
[Manufacturing SME]{.sector}

**Challenge:** target quality controls according to the product mix.

**Approach:** diagnosis of production data quality.

**Result:** a premature ML project avoided; a data roadmap defined.
:::
:::

## Training programmes

For **engineers and managers** who are to become the AI leads of their organisation: identify the right use cases, scope a project, work with providers and understand the stakes. In person, inter- or intra-company. Active learning with tailor-made **serious games** and real cases from my projects.

- **"AI and Applications" certificate** — 18 days · RNCP certification · eligible for the French CPF. A complete programme to become an AI lead: methods, tools, project management, industrial cases.
- **"AI for Manufacturing"** — 2 days · Grenoble INP continuing education. Industrial use cases: quality, maintenance, cost estimation, planning.
- **3-hour workshops** — 10 to 20 participants, 2–3 sessions a year. AI and its economic, social and environmental stakes · AI project management for executives · needs analysis and AI solution design.
- **AI for Manufacturing (EIT Manufacturing)** — 2021–2024, programme lead. European training programme on AI for manufacturing SMEs and students.

Training is delivered through Grenoble INP, a Qualiopi-certified provider.
